name: Tanvi Saxena
quote: Desk 14 in the morning with natural limewash sunlight is absolute bliss.

name: Raunak Khandelwal
quote: This place is a total gem! Amazing ambience, super chill vibes, and the coffee is seriously next level. Every sip feels premium. And let’s talk about the sandwiches — just WOW 😍 fresh, loaded, and insanely tasty. Once you visit, you’ll definitely want to come back again and again.

name: Rohan Choudhary
quote: Section-B is a great place to chill with friends. The food is delicious and well-crafted — loved the burgers, wraps, and cold coffee. The ambience is cozy and welcoming, and the staff is really polite and friendly. Service is quick, and overall the vibe is perfect for casual hangouts. Definitely worth visiting again!
favoriteOrder: Classic Velvet Flat White & House Wrap

name: Esha Shiromani
quote: This cafe is a gem! Cozy vibe, delicious coffee, and the staff are super friendly. Perfect spot to catch up with friends or get some deep focus work done with great acoustic tunes and zero rush ☕️

name: Inder Sharma
quote: Best quality food, very nice and humble staff. The ambiance is warm, welcoming, and every espresso extraction is pulled with genuine care. Section-B sets an uncompromising benchmark for craft coffee in NCR.

name: Pakhi S.
quote: Ngl one of the best places to be cozy and spend time with friends. The team is amazing, the iced lattes are unmatched, and everything was 10/10. Definitely our regular weekend study spot.
